description: Tracés des réseaux de chaleur et de froid is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by France Chaleur Urbaine. In order to contribute to the development of heating and cooling networks, which are one of the levers for the decarbonisation of buildings and the acceleration of the energy transition, France Chaleur Urbaine makes available for free download the routes of the networks identified as part of the service, i.e. Coverage: France Chaleur Urbaine. The portal shows the English title as "Traces of heating and cooling networks" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is France Chaleur Urbaine. Its keywords include energies-renouveables, transition-energetique, traces-des-reseaux, reseaux-de-froid, reseaux-de-chaleur. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
